name: Typed Confirm Dialog
description: A destructive confirm that grows out of its trigger, traps focus and enables Delete only once the exact name is typed. It lists what is lost and offers Archive instead.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The button in the card that opens the dialog.

props.name: resourceName
props.description: The exact name the visitor must type before Delete enables.

props.name: cardKicker
props.description: Small caps line above the card title.

props.name: cardTitle
props.description: The card’s heading.

props.name: cardDescription
props.default: "Removes {name}, its environments and its deploy history. Nothing is kept once it is gone."
props.description: The card’s sentence. {name} stands for the resource name.

props.name: cardHeadingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the card title, so it fits the page’s outline. The dialog title is always an h2.

props.name: kicker
props.description: Small caps line above the dialog title. It becomes the error line when a delete fails.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog title. {name} stands for the resource name.

props.name: description
props.default: "This removes the project and everything inside it. There is no recovery window and no undo."
props.description: The dialog’s sentence, read out as its description.

props.name: ledgerLabel
props.description: The heading over the ledger.

props.name: ledger
props.type: { label: string; value: number; suffix?: string }[]
props.default: Environments 12, Last deploy 3 h ago, Environment variables 47
props.description: What goes with the resource. Each figure counts up when the dialog opens; an empty array hides the ledger.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The confirm button’s label.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override the other words: pending, done, error, failed, cancel, archive, archiveFailed, field (“Type {name} to confirm”) and announceDone.

props.name: requireTyping
props.description: Ask for the exact name first. Off, Delete is a single plain confirm.

props.name: alternative
props.description: Offer “Archive instead”, which keeps environments and history.

props.name: tone
props.description: Red for removal; the theme’s ink for anything milder.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the dialog sits on, so its scrim, field and text keep their contrast.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out and the trigger owns it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires on every open and close: the trigger, Cancel, Esc, the scrim, or a finished delete.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status, for a host that tracks the delete itself. Leave it out and onConfirm’s promise drives it. Opening on a status past idle shows the confirmed name.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Fires on every status change, including the return to idle after an error or a close.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs with the typed name. Return a promise for the pending state; reject it for the error state.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Runs when the visitor picks Archive instead. A promise holds the dialog open until it settles.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer container.
